current_native.TotalPrecincts_scope: Global1322 in native response, not local precinct count

publication_scope: Individual county authority requests plus actually investigated shared state parent. This is not independent validation of every historic child as a current feed.
finer_reporting_ID_limitation: Historical 81 selected-portfolio contexts; current state source has 81 nonadministrative contexts plus _TOT. Native IDs and labels belong to different publications/vintages; no per-child equivalence is demonstrated.
correction_chronology: Only explicit source wording/differing version observations retained; decreases never repaired or allocated.
additional_notes: County/state-linked Clarity configuration actually identifies May12,2026 primary. Retained version config/status/details/vt/sum and settings plus one earlier version attempt; no November vendor counts admitted.
